title: electronic operator input hardware

specimens.name: Low-profile rectangular industrial pushbutton
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Compact rectangular late-1990s industrial pushbutton with low-profile molded bezel and plain unlit cap; unlabeled, no text or integrated display.

specimens.name: Guarded red mushroom emergency-stop
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Standard red mushroom emergency-stop in a compact yellow/gray industrial guard collar with twist/pull reset hardware; no text, arrows or surrounding panel.

specimens.name: Detented rotary encoder knob
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Compact black molded rotary encoder knob on a standardized metal/plastic bezel with visible physical detent ring and push-capable shaft form; no printed scale, digits or labels.

specimens.name: Sealed industrial rocker-switch module
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One low-profile rectangular sealed rocker switch in a molded bezel with neutral dark cap; no icon, text, lamp or surrounding panel.

specimens.name: Twelve-key membrane keypad module
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Compact beige/gray industrial membrane keypad with twelve equal blank physical key zones in a 3×4 grid and a thin molded bezel; no letters, numbers, arrows, legends or display.

specimens.name: Industrial trackball pointing module
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Compact gray panel-mount trackball with one dark ball and exactly two plain unlabeled physical buttons in a sealed bezel; no screen, keyboard or console.

specimens.name: Compact sealed two-axis joystick
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Short dark industrial joystick with molded grip, rubber bellows and compact square mounting bezel; no labels, lights or complete console.

specimens.name: Four-key soft-function key strip
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One narrow rack-console-style module containing four identical blank low-profile keys in a straight row; no display, labels, text, LEDs or surrounding panel.

global_forbidden: text, letters, numbers, arrows, icons, legends, logos or pseudo-writing
gauges, CRTs, LCDs, screen content, indicator lamps, relays, terminal blocks, wiring or diagnostic connectors
complete control panels, keyboards, desks, consoles, workstations, machines, rooms or scenes
any ninth or extra specimen, duplicate specimen, omitted specimen, merged specimen or substitution
knife switches, loose mismatched toggles, large mechanical levers or E1 three-button station blocks as the dominant vocabulary
active illumination, glow, bloom, rays, projected light or baked cast/contact shadows
photorealistic product rendering, filtered 3D render or soft studio photography

era_contract.character: late-1990s test-center operator input hardware combining standardized safety controls with lower-profile electronic selectors, encoders, membrane keypads and pointing devices
required_signals: rotary encoder rather than only mechanical selector switching
sealed compact joystick and function-key modules
replaced_previous_language: E1 round pushbutton families as the dominant interface
mechanical lever and three-pushbutton station vocabulary
operator input limited to electromechanical switches
forbidden_regressions: E1-only pushbutton station styling without electronic input devices
